binding.rule: Cpp2IL AddressAttribute RVA=Offset are raw file offsets; il2cpp executable ELF virtual address maps to fileOffset+0x4000. All runtime captures decode completely and are bound to matching device/source SHA.

geometry.webMatch: Existing (-sin(i*pi/6),cos(i*pi/6)) coordinates use the same orientation and ideal geometry after centering/scaling; actual client uses float32 sin/cos. This does not establish the server area formula.

orderedIndices.finding: Enumerates given indices in order and appends corresponding twelve-gon positions to vertex list; each index is clamped to0..11; no sorting or uniqueness enforcement in this method.

geometry.areaBoundary: Controller draws coordinates. Its examined methods do not calculate CoveredAreaPercent. Renderer self-intersection filling and server area/rounding remain separate unknowns.

orderMeaning.filter: b__23_0 shifts packed value by33 and compares to1. BuildConstellationData sets connected nodes state2(unlocked) or3(locked), while available unconnected nodes have state1. Filter therefore keeps connected nodes of both lock states.
orderMeaning.orderAccessor: b__23_1 returns low32 bits of packed value (node sequence number); b__23_2 returns low32 bits of dictionary key (position index).
orderMeaning.pipelineInference: Three delegates occur in filter/order/select shape in ExtractLinkVertexOrder. Their instantiated generic call target identities were not independently recovered; do not claim semantic sorting was observed by executing the renderer. The exact node accessor byte rules are bound observations.

coverage.finding: Unwraps encrypted integer field at this+0x28; absent field returns0. BuildConstellationData uses that stored integer and BuildStats passes it directly to LinkBonusTable.GetStatBoosts.
coverage.UI: Official locale uses {0}% without formatting transformation.

bonus.finding: Gets LinkBonusInfo for constellation order; converts integer coveredAreaPercent/100.0 through BasisPoint.FromDouble, multiplies configured StatBoostMultiplier BasisPoint by that BasisPoint, and emits identical resulting BasisPoint for each configured StatBoostId.
bonus.unknown: Server coordinate-to-percent formula and paid-reroll sampling remain unobserved. Exact game-entered integer area can be used with the verified client bonus formula.

fromDouble.roundingInstruction: 0x6280374 roundsd xmm0,xmm0,9: immediate bits1:0=01 force round toward negative infinity; bit3 suppresses precision exception. This is floor, not nearest or banker rounding.

multiply.instructionMeaning: Signed high-half multiply by0x346dc5d63886594b, arithmetic shift11 and sign correction implement signed divide by10000. Domain products are safely below signed64 overflow.

bonus.fractionalArea: Client getter and server protobuf area are integer. Web fractional geometry is still an unverified planning input, even when passed through this arithmetic.

verification.procedure: Reproduce observed signed division instruction semantics independently in Python; compare to exact signed integer division. Float conversion uses IEEE binary64 division/multiply with floor, as SSE instructions specify.

providerIterator.finding: Enumerates all StellarLinkRecordSet.Values. For each constellation, obtains its own ConstellationOrder and stored integer CoveredAreaPercent, calls LinkBonusTable.GetStatBoosts and yields every boost. No viewing-order filter, replacement by newest constellation, or multipliers across constellations occurs in this iterator.
providerIterator.cumulativeMeaning: Each retained constellation contributes its independently computed integer boost. Official contents guide separately confirms prior constellations remain active. Total tool percentage should sum per-constellation bonusBasisPoint then divide100.

rerollBoundary.finding: Constructs RerollStellarLinkRequest containing ChangeStellarLinkStarshardsLockRequest; writes constellation order and bool locks into request, then invokes SenderUtils.Send. Does not put a new polygon or computed area into the request. The local random polygon utility is not sufficient evidence of server sampling.
rerollBoundary.sampling: Server selection distribution not established; no reroll was performed by this offline analysis.

cost.finding: Uses GetLockedNodeCount to select LinkSuffleCostTable row. Cost item/amount copied directly from fields0x14/0x18; affordability compares current owned amount to configured amount. No covered-area or outcome multiplication in this path.

unknown: Server covered-area definition for crossing/order, normalization and integer rounding.

limitations: This analyzer only reads local saved files and performs no runtime process memory read, ADB operation, target code execution, injection, patching or account action.
Loaded executable code observations are controlled runtime evidence; reconstructed behavior is static derivation from those bytes.
Generated DLL method stub bodies never serve as implementation evidence.
